source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Check SUT will take uncorrect activity as DIMM uncorrectable non-fatal error via AMD RAS Tool 1.1 DRAM settings: a. CPU Common Options → Platform First Error Handling: Enabled b. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → DRAM Corrected Error Counter Enable: NoLeakMode c. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → DRAM Corrected Error Counter Start Count: FFFE (Deviate from default setting FFF5) d. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → Data Poisoning: Auto e. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → Disable Memory Error Injection: False f. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → ECC Configuration → DRAM UECC Retry: Disabled g. FCH Common Options → FCH RAS Options → Reset After SyncFlood: Enabled 1.2 MCA settings: a. CPU Common Options → Platform First Error Handling: Enabled b. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → DRAM Corrected Error Counter Enable: Disabled c. CPU Common Options → MCA Error Thresh Enable: True d. UMC Common Options → MCA Error Thresh Count: FFE (Deviate from default setting FF5) d. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → Data Poisoning: Auto e. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → Disable Memory Error Injection: False f. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → ECC Configuration → DRAM UECC Retry: Disabled g. FCH Common Options → FCH RAS Options → Reset After SyncFlood: Enabled 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 9.0 / Windows 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --listvalidumc 6. Uncorrectable error injection, enter command: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --einjdramecc --address 0x1000 --address_mask 0xffffffffffffffc0 --enablemcapolling 0 --errortype 1 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For uncorrectable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report. 5. System should shutdown and restart.
